about: The one source for /changelog/: 'features' is the overview of everything Canvas does (grouped), 'releases' is what changed and when (newest first). Every improvement adds a release entry here, and a feature when it's a new capability. See CLAUDE.md.

items.name: Pen and highlighter
items.text: Smooth ink with a mouse, finger or Apple Pencil, pressure-sensitive with Pencil.

items.name: Shapes, lines and arrows
items.text: Rectangles, ellipses, lines and arrows that attach to what they point at.

items.name: Hold to straighten
items.text: Draw a rough circle, rectangle or line, hold still, and it settles into a clean shape.

items.name: Sticky notes and text
items.text: Sticky notes in soft paper colours, text, and labels inside shapes.

items.name: Eraser
items.text: Wipe away strokes by touching them.

items.name: Smart guides
items.text: Things snap to the edges, centres and even gaps of what's nearby.

items.name: Snap to grid
items.text: An optional grid in steps of 8, shown by the background dots.

items.name: Align and distribute
items.text: Line things up or space them evenly in one tap.

items.name: Tidy up
items.text: Turn a pile of photos into neat columns with even gaps.

items.name: Groups
items.text: Group things so they move as one.

items.name: Focus mode
items.text: Hide every bar and button and keep only your board.

items.name: Endless board
items.text: Zoom from 2% to 800% and pan anywhere.

items.name: Photos
items.text: Paste, drag in or pick photos, several at once, on any device.

items.name: Crop
items.text: Crop a photo, and widen the crop again any time.

items.name: Link cards
items.text: Paste a web address to get a card with its picture and title.

items.name: Colours from a photo
items.text: Pull a photo's main colours out as swatches with hex codes.

items.name: Videos & music
items.text: Paste a video from YouTube, Vimeo, Loom or TikTok, or music from Spotify, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Deezer or Mixcloud: the card is the service's own player.

items.name: Place cards
items.text: + → Place finds a place by name, or paste a maps link, for a live map right on the board.

items.name: Font cards
items.text: Pick from 30 free typefaces for a card with a big "Aa", your sample text and the font's name.

items.name: Your board is the deck
items.text: Mark parts of the board as slides and press Play: it glides from one to the next.

items.name: Start anywhere
items.text: Play from any slide, and end on the whole board.

items.name: View links
items.text: Share a board with a link; people see it as it changes.

items.name: Likes and notes
items.text: Anyone with the link likes things and leaves notes, with just a name.

items.name: Replies
items.text: Answer a note in one short line, right under it.

items.name: Voice notes
items.text: Record a note of up to a minute; it sits on the board and anyone with the link can play it.

items.name: Your own notes
items.text: Leave notes on your own board for others, or for yourself.

items.name: Edit together, live
items.text: Draw on the same board at once, with everyone's cursor (Canvas Pro).

items.name: Export
items.text: A crisp PDF, PNG or SVG of the whole board or a selection.

items.name: Ideas & requests
items.text: Suggest an idea on the What's new page and it goes straight into the Inbox, where everyone can vote for it.

items.name: No account
items.text: Open it and start. Nothing to sign up for, ever.

items.name: Your boards on every device
items.text: Connect your phone, iPad and computers by scanning a code.

items.name: Home Screen app
items.text: Add Canvas to your iPhone or iPad Home Screen; it connects by scanning.

items.name: Back up by email
items.text: Email yourself your private link, so your boards are never lost.

items.name: Private by design
items.text: Your list of boards is encrypted on your device, and boards never show up in search.

items.name: Earlier versions
items.text: Go back to how a board looked an hour, a day or weeks ago, and restore it in one tap. Kept for 30 days.

items.name: Pencil always draws
items.text: Draw with the Pencil, move the board with your finger; your palm is ignored.

items.name: Pencil menu
items.text: Hold the Pencil still for a ring of tools and colours at its tip.

items.name: Crisp when zoomed in
items.text: Pencil strokes stay smooth, never jagged, however close you zoom.

items.name: Launcher
items.text: Press ⌘K or / and type: add anything, present, export, jump to a board. Paste a link or type a note and press Enter.

items.name: Warm paper look
items.text: Soft paper tones in light and dark mode.

items.name: Gentle motion
items.text: Things lift, land and glide like paper on a desk.

items.name: Soft sounds
items.text: Optional quiet taps and chimes, silent when your phone is.

items.name: Help that fits your device
items.text: A help centre, a welcome tour, and shortcuts for keyboard, touch or Pencil.

items.name: Room makeover
items.text: Plan a room with photos, colours, materials and a plan, then present it.

items.name: Client moodboard
items.text: Brief, mood, palette and type, presented without building a deck.

items.name: Brand identity
items.text: What the brand stands for, mood, logo directions, palette and type.

releases.title: More privacy for your email and your notes

items.text: Take your email off at any time: canvas.kawus.com/unsubscribe removes it from the updates list and from any idea you suggested.
Likes and notes on a shared board no longer carry a code that could link you from one board to another, or let someone undo your likes.
The Send idea button on this page now matches the site's other buttons.

releases.title: The launcher, videos, music, places, fonts and voice notes

items.text: The launcher: press ⌘K (Ctrl+K) or / on a computer and type to add anything, present, export or jump to another board. Paste a link, a colour code or a note and press Enter.

Videos and music on the board: paste a link from YouTube, Vimeo, Loom, TikTok, Spotify, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, SoundCloud, YouTube Music, Bandcamp, Deezer or Mixcloud and the card is that service's own player, exactly as you know it.
Place cards: + → Place finds a place by name (or paste a Google Maps or Apple Maps link) for a live map right on the board: Google's own map, or OpenStreetMap for Apple Maps links.
Font cards: + → Font offers 30 free typefaces, each shown in its own font, for the palette and type part of a moodboard.
Voice notes: + → Voice records up to a minute that anyone with the link can play.
Earlier versions: see a board as it was at any hour in the last 30 days and restore it in one tap. If someone else changed it, their name is next to the time.
Hold to straighten: draw a rough circle, rectangle or line, keep still for a moment, and it becomes a clean shape.
Straightening is more forgiving: quick circles that overshoot their start, wobbly circles and slightly bowed lines all settle into clean shapes.
Focus mode: press F, or pick it in the board menu, to hide everything but your board.
A new Brand identity moodboard template, and all templates now share one calm layout.
This page: everything Canvas does at a glance, and what's new.
Ideas & requests: vote for the ideas you want most, or suggest your own, right on this page.
The welcome page shows the latest Canvas: likes, notes and replies, the templates, hold to straighten, focus mode and more.
Each template page now shows its own board, exactly as it opens, in light and dark.
When you present, the dotted background fades away, so only your board is on show.
Ideas you suggest go straight into the Inbox on the Ideas board, so others can vote for them right away. The board reads Inbox, Planned, Working on, Delivered.
The ? help button now sits next to the zoom controls (on a phone, next to undo), so nothing covers it.
A tidier corner: focus mode now lives in the board menu (or press F) instead of a button next to the zoom controls.
Video and music players have the same rounded corners and soft shadow as the other cards.
Voice notes start playing the moment you tap them, in every browser and while presenting, and the time left counts down properly.
People with a view link can like things and leave notes, with just a name. You see it all in one list and resolve notes when they're done.
One-line replies under notes, and notes on your own board.
Feedback appears without refreshing, and hearts and pins scale with the board.
The Home Screen app connects itself by scanning the code from your computer.
A calmer Connect your devices, and you can zoom out to 2%.
Adding photos on a phone: you see them being added, and they land in view.
Shared boards never show up in search results.
Fixed: the same person showing up as several avatars while editing together.
Warm paper tones everywhere, in light and dark mode.
Gentle motion: things lift when you drag them, land softly and glide when tidied.
Optional soft sounds, quiet when your phone is on silent.
A calmer Pencil menu: a ring of six you flick through, with colours that fan out.
Pencil strokes stay smooth when you zoom in, with no jagged edges.
Hold the Apple Pencil still for a moment to open tools and colours at its tip.

releases.title: Templates, backups and the Founder licence

items.text: Free templates for a room makeover and a client moodboard, with their own pages.
Back up your boards by emailing yourself your private link.
Canvas Pro as a one-time Founder licence: live editing, no Canvas mark, every future Pro feature.
Shared boards and exports carry a small "Made with Canvas" mark.
Presentation mode: mark parts of the board as slides and press Play to glide between them.
Slides show just their number, and Play starts from slide 1.

releases.title: Help, Tidy up and Apple Pencil

items.text: A help centre, a ? button with shortcuts for your device, and a short welcome tour.
Tidy up: arrange a moodboard in one tap.
Crop photos, group things, and snap to a grid in steps of 8.
Apple Pencil always draws on iPad, and your finger moves the board.
Connect the Home Screen app by pasting your link.
Boards stay in step on all your open devices, and board links show the board's name and picture in messages.
A front page for new visitors, and Canvas starts on the Select tool so stray taps never leave a mark.
Link cards, colour swatches and colours pulled from a photo.
A grouped toolbar that stays compact.
Your private My Canvas link brings all your boards to your other devices, and All boards lists them.
View links for everyone; editing together live with Canvas Pro.
A calm, minimal whiteboard for computer and iPad: pen, shapes, text and an endless board.
Sticky notes, labels in shapes, arrows that attach, and photos.
Smart guides, align and distribute, and equal spacing.
Share with a link, and edit together live.
